title: On Strengthening the north wall before winter
subtitle: 工程建造 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 工程建造（科学与技术·工程与建造）
meta: 主题语境：工程建造（科学与技术·工程与建造）　|　核心词汇：strengthen　|　正文 348 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 strengthen 的形式与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1978 the director ① strengthened the north wall before winter in the rain, and every actor in the theatre said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three nights on, people still spoke of how quietly it was done and of how, ever since, the director ② strengthens the north wall before winter without complaint without being asked. My mother said later that to ③ strengthen the north wall before winter at all was the part nobody had expected.

By then somebody had surely ④ strengthened the north wall before winter before — a line in the poster for August 1972 hints at it — but nobody could name the person. ⑤ Strengthening the north wall before winter in the rain, the director said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve; it is not the doing of it that people remember.

My uncle, who kept the script at the far stage, meant the other thing entirely. He said that if anybody should ever ⑥ strengthen the case with two more witnesses without complaint, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again. The rule the old hands handed down was plainer still: ⑦ Strengthen the case with two more witnesses at once and never mention it again.

By 1985 the whole business had shrunk to half a line in the poster, and a new actor from the next theatre ⑧ strengthens the case with two more witnesses in the rain every night without once asking what it had cost the first time. My mother, who had watched all of it from the stage, said nothing at all; she simply ⑨ strengthened the north wall before winter again when nobody else would.

⑩ To strengthen the north wall before winter, my mother said in 1990, is not one thing but two: what you do and what the theatre remembers of it. She said the second half never grows lighter, and nowadays, whenever the theatre forgets, somebody strengthens the north wall before winter without complaint again and somebody must strengthen the north wall before winter in the rain all over again.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. v. 加固（一般过去式 strengthened the north wall before winter：1978 年导演头一回这样做，淋着雨）
B. v. 加固（一般现在 strengthens the north wall before winter：自那以后成了老习惯，不必有人开口）
C. v. 加固（不定式 to strengthen the north wall before winter：文中两处，一是母亲说的“难就难在……”，一是结尾那句格言）
D. v. 加固（过去完成时 had strengthened the north wall before winter：1972 年八月的戏报上那行字之前就有人做过）
E. v. 加固（动名词 strengthening the north wall before winter 作主语：“九分耐心、一分胆气”那一句）
F. v. 增强（strengthen the case with two more witnesses：should ever 之后的原形，指万一真要去增强又添两名证人强化这场官司）
G. v. 增强（strengthen the case with two more witnesses：祈使句，转述老手们当年立下的那条规矩）
H. v. 加固（后段两处：新来的演员照例 strengthens the case with two more witnesses，而母亲又一次 strengthened the north wall before winter）

answers.why: strengthen 意为“加固”，1978 年导演淋着雨加固入冬前把北墙加固，那是戏院里头一回有人肯这么做，故用一般过去式 strengthened。
strengthen 意为“加固”，自那以后导演毫无怨言地把这件事做了一遍又一遍，不必有人开口，故用一般现在 strengthens。
strengthen 意为“加固”，母亲说的是“难就难在肯加固入冬前把北墙加固”，此处为不定式 to strengthen the north wall before winter。
strengthen 意为“加固”，戏报里 八月 那行字说明早在 1985 年之前就有人加固过，故用过去完成时 had strengthened。
strengthen 意为“加固”，导演说“加固入冬前把北墙加固这件事是九分耐心一分胆气”，此处 strengthening the north wall before winter 作主语。
strengthen 意为“增强”，叔叔说的是“万一真有人去增强又添两名证人强化这场官司”，should ever 之后用原形 strengthen the case with two more witnesses。
strengthen 意为“增强”，老手们留下的规矩是祈使句：立刻增强又添两名证人强化这场官司（strengthen the case with two more witnesses at once），以后再也不要提起。
strengthen 意为“加固”，新来的演员每个夜晚都照例增强又添两名证人强化这场官司，从不问头一回的代价，用一般现在 strengthens。
strengthen 意为“加固”，母亲在无人肯做的时候又一次淋着雨加固入冬前把北墙加固，用一般过去式 strengthened 叙述。
strengthen 意为“加固”，结尾那句是母亲 1990 年的话：要加固入冬前把北墙加固，其实不是一件事，而是两件事——你做的那一件，和戏院记住的那一件。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1978 年，导演淋着雨加固入冬前把北墙加固；戏院里每一个演员都说这是头一回。（strengthened the north wall before winter）
多年以后，导演仍毫无怨言地做着同一件事，不必有人开口。（strengthens the north wall before winter）
母亲后来说，难就难在肯加固入冬前把北墙加固这件事本身。（to strengthen the north wall before winter）
早在 1972 年就有人加固入冬前把北墙加固，八月那天戏报上的一行字就是证据。（had strengthened the north wall before winter）
导演说过，淋着雨加固入冬前把北墙加固这件事，是九分耐心一分胆气。（strengthening the north wall before winter 作主语）
老手们留下的规矩说得明白：立刻增强又添两名证人强化这场官司，以后再也不要提起。（strengthen the case with two more witnesses，祈使句）

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 strengthen 的 3 种不同形式（过去式、第三人称、-ing、不定式等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1978 the director strengthened the north wall before winter in the rain, and nobody in the theatre forgot it.
Even now the director strengthens the north wall before winter without complaint whenever the theatre asks.
Strengthening the north wall before winter in the rain, my mother used to say, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
If anybody should ever strengthen the case with two more witnesses without complaint, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again.
A new actor from the next theatre strengthens the case with two more witnesses in the rain every night, asking nothing about the past.
When nobody else would, my mother strengthened the north wall before winter again, and the theatre remembered that half.
